result.note: each case ran on a fresh QA volume; fault = signal to the exact QA PID; recovery measured from injection to probe ready + WS RFB banner

bounds.note: waits are deadline-bounded predicate polls; startup grace/observation windows are time-as-behavior

misleading_success_output.finding: samples record HTTP 200 next to a failing probe/RFB while a layer is down (freeze case); recovery requires probe ready AND independent WS RFB banner

stale_state.finding: fresh QA volume and container per case (prep_fresh down -v before every case)

hung_commands.finding: every docker/curl/python call is bounded by timeout; the freeze case proves a SIGSTOPped x11vnc cannot hang the probe or the monitor

flaky_tests.finding: no fixed sleeps as synchronization; each case is a single run with deadline polling; recovery times are recorded, not assumed

cancel_resume.finding: case stop: docker stop while degraded exits 0 inside the 30s grace, is not restarted, does not consume budget, and a later start recovers

dirty_worktree.finding: source revision + tracked diff hash + untracked-files hash recorded per run; candidate image script hashes verified equal to the worktree

production_interference.finding: production only inspected; before/after snapshot compared (production.unchanged)

secrets_leak.finding: N/A: QA uses an empty VNC_PASSWORD and no account; records contain phase/layer/reason/time/counts and class names only

data_loss.finding: N/A: only the QA-only volume is created/removed; no wineserver -k in normal recovery
